visualReview.method: Actual PNGs directly opened through view_image, not inferred from file existence, geometry success or contact sheets. Unviewed images remain only generated evidence.
visualReview.C1StageMeaning: All ten integer scenes at 1440 light in both engines; Edge additionally all ten 390 light and 960 DSF2 scenes, 1280 critical S1/S5/runtimeS3. Both stage2 scenes in every profile and all selector/modal/noJS/print scenes.

caveat.text: SFT・選好・実行時制御も影響
caveat.runnerDoesNotAddDedicatedCaveatAssertion: Confirmed visually on the artifact-bound public images; original raw machine assertions alone do not establish this extra sentence.

meaningFindings: Different learning inputs converge on model weights; representative order and repetition caveat remain.
Prediction/target/error/update are distinguishable; SFT includes data/method-dependent fact learning.
Coverage, frequency and instruction-following are not conflated; learning weights and runtime context are distinct.
Fine-tuning behavior and factual reproducibility are evaluated separately; closed-book QA finding is not generalized to all fine-tuning.
Preference comparisons branch to distinct RLHF/DPO; no quality guarantee or measured improvement is invented.
Dotted relation does not assert a single cause; runtime S1 presents verification steps, not an improvement rate.
Runtime S2 preserves hallucination, sycophancy and refusal, including refusal-factor caveat under default hallucination focus.
Runtime S3 shows operation candidate, external permission, scoped operation and result verification; model refusal is not an access boundary.
visualReview.geometryFindings: All 66 C1 geometry records/engine and 70 complete-scene files/engine mapped; no wire-text candidates. Every recorded overlap candidate in both original runs was directly adjudicated: Edge 24 C1 + 12 inference pairs, WebKit 2 inference pairs. Actual glyphs are separated; small BBox intersections are not visible collisions.
visualReview.displayLimits: Low-height viewport captures may place a panel header under fixed navigation or show only part of a tall scene. Supplemental complete-scene clips use actual page/dialog scroll, retain viewport/CSS and restore scroll; normal vertical scrolling remains necessary. 390px scene text is smaller than desktop and expansion is available. No all-content-fits-one-screen claim.

Original stage asserts unchanged; no force click, DOM click, synthetic clock, retries that replace failed cases or product changes.

verifiedOriginalRace.conclusion: The trusted press and release straddle a READ-triggered button repositioning. Correct-button click/manual transition did not occur in this failed attempt. This is not evidence of READ overriding a successful manual onClick.

diagnosticReview.boundedRetest: All five original failure case names, original imported inference-checks assertions, public inference HTML artifact identity, trusted real stage0 selections, reading/independence and two native elapsed playback cases passed. Cause event was captured for one original case, not all five; no failure rate estimate. Original WebKit remains 66 pass / 5 fail. This is not a full corrected 71-case rerun.
diagnosticReview.helperAdoption: Candidate is reviewed, remains TEMP; repository adoption/versioning is root-owned follow-up.

limitations: Browser WebKit is not physical iPhone/Safari acceptance.
Print is CSS emulation, not physical printing; no new screen-reader test.
Static screenshots establish visible states, not motion; READ/midpoint/native-time behavior is supported by the separate raw execution logs.
No actual training, external tool execution or permission-enforcement backend is implemented or tested by these diagrams.
P1 all15-article completion is outside this C1 review.
